hello.text: Good day! I'm Mr. Tobias. I bake the bread for the whole village.

bellhaven.text: See that road, going past the hill? It goes all the way to the big city, Bellhaven. It's too far to walk there today.

again.text: Hello again! The bread is rising. Good things take a little time, don't they?

hello_bread.text: You came! I'm Mr. Tobias, the baker. Thank you for reading my letter.

bread_offer.text: The rolls are still warm. Will you help me fill the neighbors' baskets?

choices.text: Yes, I'd be glad to help!

bread_go.text: Thank you kindly! Come and stand by the table with me.

bread_later.text: That's all right. The baskets will wait here by the bakery.

bread_thanks.text: Mrs. Ruth just came by for her basket. She said it was exactly right! Bread is better when it's shared.

leaven_wonder.text: Every morning I mix a little leaven into my dough. Then the whole bowl puffs up big! It makes me think of the story Jesus told.

fishers_wonder.text: My grandpa fixed fishing nets by the river every evening. I think about the brothers who put down their nets and went with Jesus. I wonder what that was like.

flour.reply: I will! Thank you, Mr. Tobias.
flour.text: You brought the flour! And it weighs just right. Tomorrow, come and bake it with me.

baked.reply: Thank you for teaching me, Mr. Tobias!
baked.text: Our bread! From grain, to flour, to warm loaves. Thank you for helping every step of the way.

mill_offer.text: Good morning! Thank you for meeting me at the mill. Would you please help me clean the grain and weigh the flour?

choices.text: Yes, please! I'd be glad to help.

mill_go.text: Good! Come, the grain is just inside.

mill_later.text: That's all right. I'll be here by the mill.

bake_offer.text: The oven is hot and the dough has risen. Would you like to help me put the loaves in?

bake_go.text: Wonderful. Mind the heat, now. Come and stand beside me.

bake_later.text: That's all right. The oven will stay warm for a while.
